assets.title: Assets

memo.cost: Cost of asset “{{name}}” · owner's contribution in kind
memo.convert: Conversion of purchase invoice {{no}} to assets

assets.menuSub: Asset register, book values and depreciation

ui.empty: No assets yet · add one, or convert unit contents or an old purchase invoice from “Tools”.
ui.name: Asset name
ui.newNote: Added “awaiting cost” with no entry or depreciation until its cost comes from a purchase invoice or is entered.
ui.setCostNote: An item without an invoice (owned before the app or brought by the owner): debit the category account, credit capital 3100, with catch-up depreciation since purchase, dated today.
ui.costDone: Cost recorded and its entry posted
ui.transferNote: Depreciation for the days before the transfer stays on the old unit; then cost and accumulated depreciation move to the new one.
ui.disposeNote: Depreciation is posted to the date, then the book value is recorded as a disposal loss (5700). It stays in the register as “disposed”.
ui.sellNote: Depreciation is posted to the date · the difference from book value is a gain (4400) or a loss (5700).
ui.sellDone: Sale recorded and its entry posted

convert.title: Convert an old purchase invoice
convert.pick: Invoices expensed without lines · choose one
convert.previewTitle: Before executing · nothing is written before “Execute”
convert.dated: Entries are dated today, not on the invoice date, so earlier periods don't change.
convert.undoConfirm: Reverses the reclassification, the catch-up and the monthly depreciation of its assets, deletes its assets, and restores the expense.

contents.title: Unit contents to assets
contents.note: Each selected item becomes an asset “in service” and “awaiting cost” with no entry; its description goes to notes · the category is suggested from the name and can be changed.

review.pendingNote: {{n}} asset(s) with no cost or depreciation · record the cost from the Assets screen, or link it to an invoice line.
review.dupNote: Depreciation for {{month}} was posted {{n}} times from more than one device · reverse the extra.

lines.title: Invoice lines
lines.note: Optional · lines that become assets go to their category account at cost plus their tax share; the rest goes to the category expense.
lines.locked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · its lines can't be edited

err.name: Enter the asset name
err.ended: The asset is disposed or sold · no operation is possible
err.pending: The asset is awaiting its cost · record the cost first
err.notPending: The asset's cost is already recorded
err.cost: Enter a cost greater than zero
err.life: Life in months is a whole number from 1 to 600
err.salvage: Residual value must be less than the cost
err.periodClosed: Depreciation for {{month}} is posted · choose a later date
err.beforePurchase: The date is before the asset's purchase date
err.sameUnit: Choose a unit other than its current one
err.lifeLocked: Depreciation has started · life and residual value are locked
err.convertSum: Assets total ({{sum}}) exceeds what the invoice expensed ({{max}})
err.convertEmpty: Mark at least one line as an asset
err.qty: Quantity is a whole number from 1 to 500
err.undoBlocked: An asset from this invoice was transferred, disposed or sold · the conversion can't be reversed
err.linesSum: Lines total ({{sum}}) doesn't equal the amount before tax ({{base}})
err.purchaseLocked: This invoice's assets have depreciation or movements · edit the asset or reverse the conversion

payment.cancelFromDeposit: Paid from the deposit of a reservation converted to this contract · it cannot be cancelled, as cancelling would return the amount to a held deposit that can no longer be refunded or forfeited
payment.cancelBeforePayment: The cancellation date is before the payment date ({{date}}) · choose that date or later
payment.stuckDepositTitle: Deposit returned to its liability by cancelling its conversion payment
payment.stuckDepositExplain: A payment made from the deposit of a reservation converted to a contract was cancelled before cancelling was blocked, so its amount went back to 2450 while a converted reservation can no longer be refunded or forfeited. Applying settles the contract's remaining installments in order with it, using the deposit conversion entry dated {{date}} (today, or the first open day if today falls in a period whose return was filed), and the cancelled payment stays as it is.
payment.stuckDepositBlocked: The contract's remaining installments ({{room}}) are less than the stuck amount · needs your decision

vat.alreadyFiled: This period's return is already recorded as filed
vat.fileBeforeEnd: A quarter cannot be filed before it ends · its last day is {{date}}
vat.markFiledBody: The return is frozen at its current figures and exported with them. Later changes to its period show as differences to correct in a later return, and correction entries in its period are dated today. Continue?
vat.filedDone: Return recorded as filed and frozen
vat.frozenNote: Figures as filed · supporting schedules from current documents
vat.changedSince: Changed since filing · correct in item 14 of a later return
vat.unfileBody: If recorded by mistake: the return is computed from its documents again, and correction entries in its period return to their original dates. Continue?
vat.commercialRentControl: Commercial rent collected outside item 5 (its VAT comes with commercial leasing)
vat.filedDate: This date is in a filed VAT period, so no reversal or settlement can be dated in it · choose a date in an open period
vat.commercialRentBlock: Commercial rent was collected in this period ({{amount}}) and its VAT is not built into the return yet, so the return cannot be filed until it is
vat.filedEntry: A VAT return was filed for this date's period, so no payment, cash operation or manual entry can be recorded in it · choose a date in an open period

invoice.locked: An issued invoice can't be edited, returned to draft or deleted · correct it with a credit note
invoice.standardZeroRate: A standard-rated line has a zero rate · set its rate, or mark it zero-rated or exempt
invoice.creditOnIssued: A credit note applies to an issued invoice only
invoice.creditPaid: The invoice is collected · set it back to «due» to reverse the collection, then issue the note
invoice.creditReason: Enter the reason for the note
invoice.creditAmount: Enter the note amount before tax
invoice.creditOver: The note exceeds what remains of the invoice
invoice.creditNeedsConnection: A credit note takes its number from the invoice sequence · a connection is needed
invoice.creditNotCollectable: A credit note is not collected
invoice.nothingDue: Nothing remains due on this invoice
invoice.lockedNote: An issued invoice is not edited · it is corrected by a linked credit note
invoice.creditBeforeInvoice: The note is dated before its invoice
invoice.creditFiledPeriod: This date's period has a filed return · pick a date in an open period
invoice.filedPeriod: This date's period has a filed return, so no invoice is issued in it · pick a date in an open period
invoice.firstIssueOwner: The first tax invoice after activation is issued by the owner · your invoice is saved as a draft; issue it after the owner issues the first one

purchase.vatSettled: This invoice's VAT is refunded or its refund was rejected, and its entry closed the account · cancel that entry from the ledger first
purchase.filedLocked: This purchase is in a filed VAT return, so it is not edited or deleted · correct it with an entry in an open period from the ledger

key.savedToast: Key saved · upcoming backups are encrypted with it

key.askWrong: Wrong key or password · try again.
key.next: I wrote or copied it · Next
key.confirmNote: The key is now hidden · type the last five characters from what you saved, not from the screen.
key.fromPassword: Your old password stays on this device and opens your earlier backups; new backups are encrypted with the key.

upgrade.missingTitle: Backup saved except for missing files
upgrade.missingBody: A full backup of your data was saved before the upgrade, except {{count}} attached file(s) that were not found on the phone or were damaged, so they are not in it:

Backups you make (export and Google Drive) will refuse and name it until you attach it again from elsewhere or delete the attachment; the pre-upgrade backup stays under «Data and storage ← Restore».
